description: A bearded man with dark curly hair and a grey robe sits at a wooden desk, writing with a stylus on a clay tablet by the light of a small clay oil lamp with a flame and smoke. Stacks and loose clay tablets with wedge-like marks surround him. Behind him, a carved stone-like frieze shows a bearded hero grappling a lion, and a boat with oarsmen rides wavy water. Dark, warm, painterly style, filling the whole image with no visible border.
